Title: Leads page intermittently crashes: "Unexpected Application Error! Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'total')" when opened from the left menu, by URL or on refresh
Description:
Leads page crashes with "Unexpected Application Error! Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'total')"

Steps to reproduce (any CRM Administrator login, build v2.0 3110-10):
1. Sign in as CRM Administrator (one browser, one user).
2. On My Smart Workspace, wait about 3 seconds, then click Leads in the left menu.
3. If the Leads page loads, go back to My Smart Workspace and click Leads again; repeat 2-3 times.
4. Also try pressing F5 on the Leads page, or opening https://qa-crm.asquareab.com/leads directly.
→ On some attempts the whole page is replaced by "Unexpected Application Error! Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'total')". The tabs (My Leads, Unassigned, To Qualify, Ready to Convert, All Leads) are then gone too.
→ On other attempts the page and every tab load normally, so it may take a few tries.

How often:
- 31 Oct 2026 22:50-23:35 (several browsers): /leads/my crashed 4 of 4, left menu > Leads 3 of 3, /leads direct 10 of 10 OK at 22:50 but most attempts crashed at 23:30.
- Recheck with ONE browser, manual pace (1 Nov 2026 05:05 IST, 3 rounds of: menu > Leads, each tab, F5, /leads, /leads/my): round 1 crashed on menu > Leads and stayed crashed until F5; round 2 everything OK; round 3 crashed on menu > Leads, F5 and /leads direct, then /leads/my loaded. 13 of 27 checks crashed.
- So it is intermittent and not caused by parallel sessions; My Leads does not crash every time (it loaded in all 3 direct opens in the recheck).

Actual: on the failing attempts the whole page is replaced by the error and the user has to reload, sometimes several times, to get the Leads page back.
Expected: the Leads page and every tab load normally.

Technical detail for the developer:
- Every API call of the page returns 200 with data (e.g. /api/v1/leads/tab-counts → {"all":227,"my":181,"unassigned":14,"qualification":86,"conversion":21}; /api/v1/leads?limit=20&offset=0&sortBy=captured&sortDir=desc&mineOnly=true → items), so it is a front-end error: a component reads ".total" of an object that is undefined (likely a pagination / count object before or without data).
- Stack: TypeError at index-CzIlLt4.js:20:56221 (useMemo, format-api-error-vrlPyNe7.js:1:7730).
- No error boundary on the route, so the whole page is lost.

Impact: interrupts lead work on QA and made automated runs unreliable for the retest of #144, #147, #149 and #165 (they need to create or open a lead first). Also seen on builds 3010-07 and 3110-10.
Retest Comments: Reproduced on 31 Oct 2026 and rechecked on 1 Nov 2026 with one browser at manual pace: still intermittent (13 of 27 checks crashed; one full round had no crash). Evidence in Retesting/evidence/: Leads_Page_Crash_My_Leads.png, Leads_Page_Crash_Menu_Click.png, Leads_Page_Crash_Direct_URL.png, Leads_Page_Crash_attempts.txt, Leads_Page_Recheck_1worker.txt.
